title: SSRIs that made him suicidal; his psychiatrist quit
summary: Dylan Borland tells of SSRIs that made him suicidal; his psychiatrist quit, about 2016-2017 at VA, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: then they put me on those meds that made me suicidal and that's why my first doctor quit.

plain: Dylan Borland, a military veteran who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, describes his treatment in 2016 and 2017 through the VA, the US government health system for veterans. He says doctors put him on SSRIs, a common type of antidepressant, that made him suicidal, and that this is why his first psychiatrist quit, pointing to his medical records as backing his account of how he was treated.
